name: Liberty Security Services
notes:
Liberty Security Services, LLC - AS21990.

One IPv4 prefix, 206.109.108.0/23, allocated directly by ARIN. RPKI ROA
published and valid (origin AS21990, maxLength /23); route objects registered
in ARIN and RADB. No IPv6 allocation at this time.

Footprint: Hudson Valley, NY Capital Region, and NY metro.

The edge is in Lake Katrine, NY - Liberty's own building, not a carrier-neutral
facility. That is why the facility and exchange lists are empty: there is no
cross-connect to order. Private interconnect can be discussed.

Peering requires a signed mutual agreement before turn-up.

peering@as21990.net - peering requests
noc@as21990.net - operational and routing issues
abuse@as21990.net - traffic originating from our space

https://as21990.net
